[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Duty - the faction's goal is to protect the world from the contamination of the Zone. A fairly powerful militarized faction. Good weaponry and a predisposition to fighting mutants guarantee success in capable hands.

Maximum decentralization: You and your gang are a threat to the world. Time to deal with you!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: We want to establish a ceasefire with you. Do you agree?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Maximum decentralization: We propose an alliance. Together we could carry out a couple of operations against our enemies. Do you agree?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Freedom - an anarchist faction that is hostile to government troops and research groups. Plans to make Army Warehouses its main base before advancing further north.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Maximum decentralization: Alright, man, get ready! We're comin' for you and your crew.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: Dude, maybe we can call it a day, huh?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Maximum decentralization: Hey man, how about an alliance? Whaddya think?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Maximum decentralization: Sorry, dude, but our paths diverge.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Maximum decentralization: Hey, man! Freedom's runnin' low on free cash... Could you spare us an amount like this:

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Maximum decentralization: Looks like coffins are gonna get expensive!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Maximum decentralization: Nah, we're not down with that.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Maximum decentralization: Nah, dude, we're passin' on this one.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Maximum decentralization: Man, nah, what? We ain't ready to drop that kinda cash right now...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! The faction now controls Army Warehouses. Monolith has been pushed back to the Radar, and the Military at the Warehouses have been completely wiped out. The situation has stabilized, but everyone knows it won't last long. Monolith will clearly attempt another push, so command is accelerating the relocation of the base to Army Warehouses. It's expected this success can be developed further to push north through the Brain Scorcher. Currently, it's impossible to approach it. Someone needs to shut it down first, so we'll have to wait for now...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Faction detachments were completely destroyed at Army Warehouses. It's now unknown what happens next, as pushing north through Limansk is impossible - the group sent there was wiped out, it's a hotspot now, and the faction has lost its foothold at the Warehouses... Plans to relocate the base north have gone up in smoke. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Time's up. You failed to gain control over Army Warehouses. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Time's up. You failed to gain control over Army Warehouses. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Mercenaries - a fairly secretive militarized faction specializing in fulfilling various contracts received both from within the Zone and from outside. Good weaponry, experienced fighters, and interests in Army Warehouses can allow the faction to firmly establish itself at this location.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Maximum decentralization: A contract has been issued for you. Nothing personal. Just business.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: This war benefits neither of us. How about peace?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Maximum decentralization: Closer cooperation with you would be advantageous for us. Do you agree?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Maximum decentralization: We will no longer cooperate with you.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Maximum decentralization: We've had a couple of hiccups with certain contracts. We could use some financial assistance in the amount of:

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Maximum decentralization: We won't be doing any more business with you!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Maximum decentralization: Pity. You're missing out on your profit.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Maximum decentralization: That's not advantageous for us right now.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Maximum decentralization: Very well. We hope for a mutually beneficial partnership.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Maximum decentralization: That's not advantageous for us at the moment.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Maximum decentralization: We don't have many contract bonuses right now, so we can't help.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! The faction now controls Army Warehouses. It wasn't in the original plans, but the situation played out this way... Currently, this success is being assessed and plans are being drawn up to utilize such an excellent foothold. However, Monolith fighters on the Radar are unlikely to sit still - the Barrier must be reinforced. Other factions are unlikely to act right now as they're tied down in Limansk. This gives us a chance to catch our breath and prepare for subsequent engagements...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Faction fighters were completely wiped out at Army Warehouses. The contractors won't be pleased with this. The faction's reputation is on the line... Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Time's up. You failed to gain control over Army Warehouses. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Maximum decentralization: You failed to achieve the objectives. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Monolith - a faction serving as the shield of the C-Consciousness. Main goal: protect the Zone from any external interference. Extremely hostile to all other factions. Despite superior weaponry, they struggle to advance on Army Warehouses as main forces are concentrated in Limansk.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith commands us to make peace with you. Do you comply?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith decrees we shall become your allies.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith is displeased with our alliance!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Maximum decentralization: By the will of the Great Monolith, we submit a request for a funds transfer to our brethren in the amount of:

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Maximum decentralization: Locate and eradicate! *Interlocutor has blacklisted you*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith would never approve of this! *Interlocutor removed you from friends*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Maximum decentralization: You shall know the wrath of the Monolith! *Interlocutor exited the chat*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Maximum decentralization: And the day shall come when the Monolith shines once more in all its glory! *Interlocutor exited the chat*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith will surely not grant His consent. *Interlocutor exited the chat*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Maximum decentralization: Trust no one but the Monolith and His brethren, no one. *Interlocutor added you to friends*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith commands no mercy for the faithless! *Interlocutor removed you from chat*

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith commands pity for the blind and has ordered a funds transfer to you.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
Maximum decentralization: Then we shall find you and destroy you!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes
Maximum decentralization: It could be no other way. All by the will of the Great Monolith!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No
Maximum decentralization: You defy the will of the Monolith to your detriment.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes
Maximum decentralization: May our brethren rejoice and our enemies tremble!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! The faction now controls Army Warehouses. The situation has stabilized, but everyone knows it won't last long. In Limansk, stalkers are pushing deep into faction territory. Therefore, Monolith fighters are redirecting their main forces there. There is also a threat of a certain stalker group breaking through to CNPP, so further southern advancement through Army Warehouses has been paused. We'll have to wait for now...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Faction detachments were completely destroyed at Army Warehouses... And on top of that, fierce battles are raging in Limansk, where the faction is suffering massive losses. The situation is nearing catastrophe. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Time's up. You failed to gain control over Army Warehouses. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Maximum decentralization: You failed to achieve the objective! Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.mutants.:main].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! Hordes of monsters have overrun Army Warehouses. This territory has now become too dangerous. Even Monolith fighters no longer attempt to breach the Barrier. However, factions will not leave this situation as is and will likely attempt to reclaim the territory in the future.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.mutants.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Maximum decentralization: You were exterminated at Army Warehouses! Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.mutants.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Time's up, but mutants failed to claim Army Warehouses for themselves... Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Military - remnants of a combat unit entrenched at Army Warehouses. Attempting to secure evacuation from command, which holds an entirely opposite view of the situation. Excellent gear for engaging stalkers, but poorly adapted to anomalous Zone threats.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Maximum decentralization: Your presence in the Zone is now deemed illegal. If caught, execution on sight!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: Command believes we should reduce operational activity. How about a ceasefire?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Maximum decentralization: Command believes we need an ally in the Zone for joint operations. Do you agree?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Maximum decentralization: Government forces require financial assistance for a new general's mansion... Ahem. For... For special operations in the amount of. Will you help?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Maximum decentralization: How exactly are we to interpret that?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Maximum decentralization: No, we cannot overlook your presence in the Zone.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Maximum decentralization: Alright, we will overlook your presence in the Zone...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Maximum decentralization: No, we cannot overlook your presence in the Zone.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Maximum decentralization: The army needs an ally in the Zone. Very well, we agree.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Maximum decentralization: No, we do not provide financial assistance!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Maximum decentralization: Yes, command has agreed to assist you financially.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
Maximum decentralization: Refused? Well... That was a mistake on your part!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No
Maximum decentralization: Refused? Well... That was a mistake on your part!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! The faction now controls Army Warehouses. Monolith has been pushed back to the Radar, and Freedom's plans to relocate their base to Army Warehouses have been thwarted. Communications with HQ have been restored, but no reinforcements are expected for now due to the fighting in Limansk. We'll have to wait for now...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Faction detachments were completely destroyed at Army Warehouses. It's now unknown what happens next, as pushing north through Limansk is impossible - the group sent there was wiped out, it's a hotspot now, and the Military have lost their foothold at the Warehouses... Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Time's up. You failed to gain control over Army Warehouses. You are demoted. Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Maximum decentralization: You failed to achieve the objective! Defeat!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Loners - a voluntary union of stalkers at Army Warehouses with the goal of holding Monolith at the Barrier. Their advantage lies in a natural predisposition to artifact hunting, which can greatly improve financial standing in capable hands. The faction must define its developmental priorities.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: Time to end this bloodshed. We're ready for peace. Are you?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Maximum decentralization: We wish to form an alliance with you. Do you agree?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Maximum decentralization: We've hit some financial difficulties. Could use some help. We're looking for a sum like this:

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Maximum decentralization: You backstabbing rat! War it is, then!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Maximum decentralization: We see no necessity for that at the moment.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Maximum decentralization: Yes, we agree to a ceasefire.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Maximum decentralization: We are not sure this is needed right now.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Maximum decentralization: Regrettably, we are not in a position to provide that amount at this time.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Maximum decentralization: Alright, we will transfer that sum to you.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! Faction fighters now control Army Warehouses, but although Monolith has been pushed back to the Radar, this clearly won't last long. We'll need to gather strength to hold them at the Barrier. They're expected to make new push attempts fairly soon, so preparations must start now, as Loners can't reach Limansk. Other factions are engaged in fierce battles there right now...

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Maximum decentralization: Faction detachments were completely destroyed at Army Warehouses. It's now unknown what happens next, as pushing north through Limansk is impossible - it's a hotspot now, and the faction has lost its foothold at the Warehouses... Defeat!
